mercimek.name: Soup Lantil
mercimek.description: Soup lantil lakay prepare nan stil klasik, konplete ak yon sòs bè.

tas-kebabi.name: Gousto Vyann Bèf Tik
tas-kebabi.description: Vyann bèf, legim sezonye, ak sòs espesyal restoran nou an kwit dousman.

kuzu-tandir.name: Lam Pèpi Kwit Dousman
kuzu-tandir.description: Lam tandoori siyati restoran nou an, kwit dousman sou chalè ba.

pirinc-pilavi.name: Pilaf Diri
pirinc-pilavi.description: Pilaf diri Baldo, bè, ak leje.

firin-sutlac.name: Budin Diri Boukannen
firin-sutlac.description: Budin diri boukannen nan fason tradisyonèl, prepare ak lèt bèf chak jou.

kuru-fasulye.name: Gulya Pwa Blan ak Vyann Bèf
kuru-fasulye.description: Pwa İspir, vyann bèf koupe an kib, ak pasta tomat senp restoran.

izgara-kofte.name: Boulett Vyann Grille
izgara-kofte.description: Boulett vyann bèf stil boutye ak piman griye ak tomat.

ayran.name: Ayran Batri
ayran.description: Bèrmèk tradisyonèl batri ak anpil kim, fèt ak krèm asid òdinè.

ezogelin-corbasi.name: Soup Ezogelin
ezogelin-corbasi.description: Yon soup tradisyonèl restoran kote lens wouj, bulgur, ak diri rankontre ak mant.

tarhana-corbasi.name: Soup Tarhana
tarhana-corbasi.description: Tarhana fè lakay, yon klasik Anatolian kwit dousman ak tomat ak mant sèch.

yayla-corbasi.name: Soup Yogout ak Diri
yayla-corbasi.description: Yon soup yayla fre ak krèmè prepare ak yogout, diri, ak mant sèch.

iskembe-corbasi.name: Soup Trip
iskembe-corbasi.description: Soup trip bèf apwopriye sèvi ak epis li yo ak vinèg lay.

dugun-corbasi.name: Soup Maryaj
dugun-corbasi.description: Soup tradisyonèl maryaj prepare ak vyann mouton rache epi bay gou ak yon marinen sitwon.

tavuk-suyu-corbasi.name: Soup Bwason Poul
tavuk-suyu-corbasi.description: Yon soup geri prepare ak pasta mens kwit nan bouyon zo ak vyann poul rache.

domates-corbasi.name: Soup Tomat
domates-corbasi.description: Yon gou rich kwit ak tomat mi, bè, ak basil, konplete ak fwomaj.

sebze-corbasi.name: Soup Legim
sebze-corbasi.description: Yon soup limen restoran prepare ak legim sezonye, lwil oliv, ak zèb fre.

beyran-corbasi.name: Soup Tounin Abriko Piman
beyran-corbasi.description: Yon soup rejyonal prepare sou chalè wo ak tounin bouk, diri, lay, ak piman cho.

kelle-paca-corbasi.name: Soup Tèt ak Pye
kelle-paca-corbasi.description: Yon soup bouyon zo rich prepare ak pye vyann bèf ak vyann tèt bouyi pou èdtan lontan.

sehriye-corbasi.name: Soup Vermiselli
sehriye-corbasi.description: Soup chak jou prepare ak bouyon poul ak tomat, vermis, ak pèsi.

tavuk-sis.name: Boukannen Poul
tavuk-sis.description: Moso poul marinen ak epis espesyal, sèvi ak pwav ak tomat boukannen.

kasap-sucuk.name: Sucuk Boukanen
kasap-sucuk.description: Sosis bèf pikant kwit sou chabon, ak legim boukannen ak zonyon ak sumak.

karisik-izgara.name: Gril Melanje
karisik-izgara.description: Yon plak gril anpil ak divès ki gen boulèt, boukannen poul, kotèl mouton, ak sosis.

nohut-yemegi.name: Gouyad Pwa Kikor ak Bèf
nohut-yemegi.description: Yon repa lakay ak pwa chich ak vyann bèf koupe an ti moso, kwit dousman nan yon chodyè kwiv.

patlican-musakka.name: Mousaka Zaboka
patlican-musakka.description: Zaboka fri, vyann bèf moulen, ak mousaka kwit nan fou ak sòs tomat, stil restoran.

zeytinyagli-taze-fasulye.name: Pwa Vèt nan Lwil Oliv
zeytinyagli-taze-fasulye.description: Yon klasik kwit nan lwil oliv ak pwa vèt, tomat, ak zonyon, sèvi frèt.

tavuk-sote.name: Poul Sote
tavuk-sote.description: Moso poul yo sote sou chalè fò ak pwav koulè, djondjon, ak tomat.

izmir-kofte.name: Boulett Vyann Stil Izmir
izmir-kofte.description: Yon plat prensipal tradisyonèl ak boulèt vyann bèf, pòmdetè, ak pwav kwit nan sòs tomat.

etli-bezelye.name: Pwa ak Vyann Bèf
etli-bezelye.description: Manje chak jou kwit nan yon chodyè ak vyann bèf koupe an kib, pwa, kawòt, ak pòmdetè.

patlican-oturtma.name: Melongèn Kwit nan Fou ak Vyann Bouyi
patlican-oturtma.description: Sous lang lan prepare nan fou a ak melongèn, vyann tè pikant, ak sòs tomat ak lay.

salgam-suyu.name: Ji Navèt Fermente
salgam-suyu.description: Js navèt pikant tradisyonèl fermenté ak kawòt wouj ak ledven boulgur.

maden-suyu.name: Dlo Mineral
maden-suyu.description: Dlo mineral natirèl ki sou avèk frèt.

su.name: Dlo Sous Natirèl
su.description: Dlo sous natirèl ki sèvi frèt nan yon boutèy vè.

kola.name: Cola
kola.description: Yon bwason gazeuz klasik ki sèvi frèt ak glas.

gazoz.name: Soda Sitron Tik
gazoz.description: Soda tradisyonèl ak gou, fre, epi sèvi frèt san anyen ladan l.

turk-kahvesi.name: Kafe Tik
turk-kahvesi.description: Kafe Tik tradisyonèl ak kim, kwit sou chalè wo nan yon cezve kwiv.

demleme-cay.name: Te Bouyi Tik
demleme-cay.description: Te Rize cho fèk bouyi nan yon vè ak ren mens.

ev-yapimi-limonata.name: Limonad Fè Lakay
ev-yapimi-limonata.description: Limonad fre ki prepare chak jou ak sitwon fre, mant, ak yon ti sik.

hosaf.name: Konpot Fwi Chak Jou
hosaf.description: Konpot fèt lakay bouyi chak jou ak rezen sèch, abiko, oswa prun selon sezon an.

iskender-kebabi.name: Bursa İskender Kebab
iskender-kebabi.description: Vyann lan vire sou yon eskewè sou pide, sèvi ak sòs tomat, bè cho, ak yogout.

kazandibi.name: Desè Lèt Karamèlize
kazandibi.description: Yon desè lèt tradisyonèl ki byen karamèlize, ak yon teksti swa.

tavuk-gogsu.name: Desè Lèt Othoman
tavuk-gogsu.description: Yon desè lèt lejè ak fib, prepare ak yon resèt tradisyonèl, sèvi ak kannèl.

keskul.name: Poudin Lèt Zanmann
keskul.description: Desè lèt nan stil Ottoman konplete ak gou zanmann ak kokoye.

irmik-helvasi.name: Halva Semolina
irmik-helvasi.description: Halva semolina, fri ak bè ak nwa pye pye, sèvi cho ak graine.

kabak-tatlisi.name: Desè Joumou ak Tahini
kabak-tatlisi.description: Joumou a, kwit dousman nan pwòp ji li, sèvi ak tahini ak nwa.

ayva-tatlisi.name: Desè Kwen
ayva-tatlisi.description: Kwen kwit ak clou de girofle ak kannèl, sèvi ak krèm kole ak nwa.

revani.name: Gato Sèmol
revani.description: Desè klasik restoran an kote gato sèmol lan dous rankontre ak siròp sant sitwon.

ekmek-kadayifi.name: Poudin Pen ak Krèm Boufer
ekmek-kadayifi.description: Poudin pen ki repoze nan siròp karamelize sèvi ak krèm boufer boufalo.

cevizli-baklava.name: Baklava Nwa
cevizli-baklava.description: Plizyè kouch trè mens woule, baklava krispy fèt ak anpil nwa ak bè senp.
